frequency_question: What proportion of substantive renewals successfully meet the strict formal criteria of a signed bilateral treaty or MoU confirmed by major official reporting prior to expiration?
membership_rule: Members are formal attempts to renew expiring interstate river water treaties. Excluded are domestic water disputes, unilateral declarations without treaty status, and non-river border agreements.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 major historical precedents identified where formal bilateral water treaties reached expiration or revision cycles and resulted in signed treaties or formal MoUs.
known_gaps: Minor local basin agreements omitted due to lack of major press reporting verification.
skeleton: Total formal river treaty renewals and major successor instruments globally between riparian neighbors since 1990 meeting official threshold criteria.
multiplier: 4 hits / 4 enumerated baseline major treaty instances
validity_reason: State treaty ratification practices and formal diplomatic verification standards change slowly over decades.
